fixed_upstream.relevant_behavior: The fixed upstream uses OneKeyBind openGuiKeybind with default Keyboard.KEY_F and a config.openGui callback; it does not contain the current Minecraft 26.1.2 Fabric KeyMapping client path.

findings.summary: The default Right Shift settings mapping did not open settings when the client delivered the physical key as a scancode event.
findings.upstream_behavior: In Minecraft 26.1.2, KeyboardHandler.keyPress calls InputConstants.getKey(KeyEvent), then KeyMapping.set and KeyMapping.click. InputConstants.getKey selects SCANCODE when KeyEvent.key() is -1. The fixed upstream only provides a legacy OneKeyBind callback and does not define this 26.1.2 boundary.

parent_reproduction.impact: The controller only drained openKey.consumeClick() at END_CLIENT_TICK, so the scancode event did not reach the settings opener. The same launch still passed /fh open and /farmhelper open, isolating the failure to default Right Shift input handling.

findings.incompatibility: InputConstants.Key equality includes both type and value. SCANCODE/54 therefore does not address a KEYSYM/344 mapping, even though the native GLFW state for the configured Right Shift key is down.
findings.replacement: Keep the vanilla KeyMapping click queue as the first path, drain it fully, combine KeyMapping.isDown() with InputConstants.isKeyDown(client.getWindow(), configuredKey), and accept only a rising edge of that combined state. Use the existing null-screen guard for key opens, preserve the command request parent behavior, and reset the edge state when a remap is applied.
automated_evidence: FarmHelperSettingsControllerTest.realClientBoundaryReproducesRightShiftScancodeMissAndFallbackOpensOnce proves the parent SCANCODE/54 -> KEYSYM/344 miss at the actual 26.1.2 KeyEvent/InputConstants/KeyMapping boundary, then proves one fallback opening and no held-key duplicate.

FarmHelperSettingsControllerTest.vanillaKeysymQueueAndPhysicalStateShareOneRisingEdgeAndScreenGuard proves KEYSYM/344 delivery, click-queue draining, held/repeat suppression, release/repress behavior, and the existing-screen guard.
FarmHelperSettingsControllerTest.unrelatedKeyDoesNotReachMappingOrPhysicalFallbackAndRemapStillUsesKeysym proves unrelated and left-Shift rejection plus standard remap to KEYSYM/65.
FarmHelperCommandTreeTest and ClientCommandScreenCloseTest preserve both farmhelper and fh command paths through the shared opener boundary.
